summary: CEIR-15 sec-39 the ceir.frame dialect: the AUTHORABLE FRAME GRAPH as CEIR (REN-36's .frame.toml asset system, promoted). A frame.graph REGION contains the frame's resource.declare/import ops (graph-owned + external resources -- the frame graph's resources ARE resource dialect values, so the CEIR-12b/c/d lifetime/alias/memory planner plans them; NO parallel frame.resource op), its frame.draw_list ECS-query declares, and its frame.pass work-unit nodes. A pass' MECHANIC is a registered ExecutorTypeId named by the `executor` SYMBOL attr (never one-op-per-executor -- that recreates the retired FramePassKind enum); its read/written resources ride ONE variadic `resources` operand tail tokened by the `access` string (opgen: only the last operand may be variadic -- the 13a compute.dispatch / 14b render.draw house pattern), so CEIR's resource_root + ops_hazard machinery DERIVES the frame's barriers + transient lifetimes (the sec-159 realization: topology/lifetime/history become a CEIR analysis pass, not a hand-rolled one). HISTORY (ping-pong / TAA prev-frame) rides resource.declare's EXISTING lifetime=history + history_length (CEIR-12b); frame.history(R) is the prev-frame READ -- a distinct op whose result is its own resource_root, so a read-of-prev vs write-of-curr does NOT derive a false intra-frame RAW (the RMW scar's frame edition, fixed STRUCTURALLY). Frame-scoped SIZING (width/height/scale/samples/mips/depth_buffer/no_alias/resizable) + buffer usage (indirect_args/structured/counter) ride as OPEN attrs on the resource.declare inside a frame.graph region (the open-attr precedent is IN-dialect: declare already carries open planner tags streaming_priority/budget_class), validated by Context::find_frame_misuse WHEN the declare sits in a frame.graph region. Executor-specific pass config (shader/kernel/technique/draw_list/clear/blend/depth/sampler/render-state/role-bits) rides as OPEN attrs on frame.pass, validated at COOK against the EXECUTOR's schema (15c), NOT the op verifier -- CEIR attrs are an open set (the opgen verifier checks only required attrs). Migration: .frame.toml + FrameGraphBuilder both END at ceir.frame via a FrameGraphDesc<->ceir.frame converter pair with a round-trip-identity gate (15a-3); the old runtime consumes ceir.frame through the backward converter (incremental 15e); ADR-0106 superseded in place @ 15f; asset IDs preserved. ADR-0127. Reference/interpreter semantics = a NAMED-FORWARD typed NoSemantics (the resource/async precedent): a frame op executes when the frame runtime + provider binding land (15d/15e).

ops.name: draw_list
ops.summary: An ECS-query draw list (all/any/none component filters + cull/sort/limit); produces a draw-list value a pass consumes.
ops.docs: frame.draw_list { all, any, none, cull, sort, limit } -> a draw_list value. Pure (a declaration). find_frame_misuse: all/any/none comma-separated component tokens; cull/sort closed vocabularies; limit >= 0; legal ONLY inside a frame.graph region.

results.name: list
results.doc: the draw-list value (a frame `draw_list` extern type; the host resolves the query to pre-resolved DrawItems at execute -- CEIR never sees a scene type).

attributes.name: all
attributes.doc: comma-separated component names an entity must have ALL of (empty = no all-constraint).

attributes.name: any
attributes.doc: comma-separated component names an entity must have AT LEAST ONE of (empty = ignored).

attributes.name: none
attributes.doc: comma-separated component names an entity must have NONE of (empty = no exclusion).

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: CEIR-15a-3b the draw-list's authored NAME (asset-id preservation + the backward FrameGraphDesc round-trip; attr-only, not a SymbolTable entry).

attributes.name: cull
attributes.doc: the cull mode: none | frustum | frustum_occlusion (absent = frustum). A CLOSED vocabulary -- find_frame_misuse enforces it.

attributes.name: sort
attributes.doc: the sort mode: none | front_to_back | back_to_front | material (absent = none). A CLOSED vocabulary, enforced.

attributes.name: limit
attributes.doc: the max draw count (0 = unlimited). find_frame_misuse: >= 0.

ops.name: graph
ops.summary: The whole-frame REGION container: a graph region holding the frame's resource declares, draw-list declares, and passes.
ops.docs: frame.graph { <resource.declare/import>* <frame.draw_list>* <frame.pass>* } -- the frame container, RESULTLESS, one graph region. Effects: GPUCommand + ambient MemoryReadWrite (region ambient; passes carry precise effects). The present endpoint is a frame.pass executor="present". find_frame_misuse: the region's ops are resource.declare/import, frame.draw_list, frame.pass, frame.history (NestedNonFrameOp otherwise); resource.declare frame-scoped attrs are validated HERE (in-region); EXACTLY one frame.graph per module this slice (MultipleGraphs, CEIR-15c-1a — subgraphs are the named-forward). sec-39 forward capabilities (subgraphs/includes/injection/replacement/multi-window) are named-forward.

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: an optional frame identity/debug name (attr-only this slice; asset-id preservation is the converter's job -- sec-126 'preserve asset IDs').

attributes.name: schema
attributes.doc: the source .frame.toml schema version (kFrameSchemaVersion; absent = current). Round-trips so a re-emit matches the authored asset.

ops.name: history
ops.summary: The previous-frame read of a lifetime=history resource (ping-pong / TAA prev-frame); a distinct op ⇒ its own resource_root.
ops.docs: frame.history(%history_resource) { frames_back } -> the previous-frame value (operand's underlying type). Pure. find_frame_misuse: operand(0) a lifetime=history resource.declare result (HistoryOperandNotHistory) DECLARED in this frame.graph region (OperandOutsideGraph, CEIR-15c-1a); frames_back >= 1. The structural RMW fix: a distinct op result is its own resource_root, so read-of-prev vs write-of-curr are different identities.

operands.name: resource
operands.doc: a lifetime=history resource.declare result -- the ping-pong ring whose PREVIOUS-frame contents this reads.

results.name: prev
results.doc: the previous-frame value; type = operand(0)'s underlying resource type. A DISTINCT op result ⇒ its OWN resource_root ⇒ a read here vs a write of the current frame does not derive a false intra-frame RAW.

attributes.name: frames_back
attributes.doc: how many frames back to read (absent = 1, the TAA prev-frame case). find_frame_misuse: >= 1 (and, when the ring depth is known, <= the operand's history_length -- HistoryFramesBackInvalid).

ops.name: pass
ops.summary: A frame work-unit node: run the `executor` MECHANIC over the `resources` (tokened by `access`), inside a frame.graph.
ops.docs: frame.pass(%resources...) { executor=@mechanic, access="...", for_each, queue, shader?/kernel?/technique?, <open executor params> } -- RESULTLESS, legal ONLY inside a frame.graph region. Effects: GPUCommand + ambient MemoryReadWrite (15d narrows per-operand from access). find_frame_misuse: executor a Symbol (ExecutorNotSymbol); access token-count == num operands + tokens in {r,w,rw}; for_each/queue closed vocabularies; every operand resource- or draw_list-kinded. Executor-specific params ride as OPEN attrs, validated at cook against the executor schema (15c). NestedNonFrameOp if outside a frame.graph region. CEIR-15c-1a per-operand guards: every operand DEFINED in this frame.graph region (OperandOutsideGraph); a lifetime=history resource is READ only via frame.history, never as a direct r/rw operand (HistoryReadNotThroughFrameHistory); a frame.history result is never WRITTEN (HistoryWriteThroughHistory).

operands.name: resources
operands.doc: the pass' read/written resources (resource.declare/import/frame.history results) AND its draw-list operands (frame.draw_list results), in SLOT order; each one's ACCESS is the matching `access` token, its ROLE derives from its TYPE CLASS (a draw_list is not a memory resource -- the hazard walk skips it).

attributes.name: executor
attributes.doc: the pass MECHANIC name: a built-in (scene.raster / fullscreen.raster / compute.dispatch / transfer.copy / mesh.raster / raytrace.pipeline / present / ...) or an app's custom id. ExecutorTypeId = fnv1a_64(name), derived at the boundary (cook-id == record-id). absent/non-symbol = ExecutorNotSymbol.

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: CEIR-15a-3b the pass' authored NAME (asset-id preservation + the backward FrameGraphDesc round-trip; attr-only).

attributes.name: access
attributes.doc: per-operand access over the `resources` tail: comma-separated {r|w|rw} in operand order, one token per operand (empty = zero operands). A draw-list operand takes r. find_frame_misuse checks token-count == num operands and each token in {r,w,rw}.

attributes.name: for_each
attributes.doc: graph-EXPANSION metadata (NOT executor-specific): none | light.cascades | views.stereo | cube.faces | lights.shadow_casting (absent = none). One declaration -> N passes, EXPANDED at 15d lowering (so lifetime/barriers/aliasing need no special case). A CLOSED vocabulary, enforced.

attributes.name: for_each_arg
attributes.doc: the for_each argument (e.g., the cascade count for light.cascades). Only meaningful with for_each != none.

attributes.name: queue
attributes.doc: the QUEUE request: graphics | async (absent = graphics). ⛔ async is a REQUEST, not a guarantee -- a single-queue adapter runs it on graphics and the graph SAYS SO through its counters. A CLOSED vocabulary, enforced.

attributes.name: shader
attributes.doc: the pass' CKIR shader program identity (a raster/fullscreen pass); a SYMBOL so it is typed + findable. The CDEP dependency extraction is 15c.

attributes.name: kernel
attributes.doc: the pass' CKIR compute kernel identity (a compute pass). CDEP extraction = 15c.

attributes.name: technique
attributes.doc: the pass' material-technique identity (a scene-raster pass, sec-45). CDEP extraction = 15c.
